claims.name: hW

claims.name: hTactual

claims.name: hpositive

claims.name: hzero
claims.priorIndependentReason: The qualified zero contract gives exactly d=e=Tclip=0 on V=0 and makes no physical-T assertion.

claims.name: hcap
claims.priorIndependentReason: Real abs of the i-th g-coordinate, fixed sqrt(n) division and min with the fixed compact threshold prove full-sample measurability.

claims.name: hpdel
claims.priorIndependentReason: The retained Pi map has each coordinate equal to full evaluation at j.val, so measurable_pi_iff applies with no inhabitant or filler.

claims.name: hDret
claims.priorIndependentReason: The existing retained pair-sum witness is divided by the fixed original sqrt(n)*(n-1).

claims.name: hJret

claims.name: hBret

claims.name: hE

claims.name: hDdeleq

claims.name: hJdeleq
claims.priorIndependentReason: Definitional unfolding exposes the existing erased original row-square sum equality, preserving its denominator.

claims.name: hB1deleq
claims.priorIndependentReason: Rewrites only Jdel to Jret(pdel ξ) in the exact same budget.

claims.name: hDdel

claims.name: hJdel

claims.name: hAdel

claims.name: hB1del
